field_meanings.epoch_seconds: Per-epoch monotonic duration from epoch-loop tick to immediately before epoch diagnostic CSV append; includes augmentation/train, canonical train and validation evaluation, frozen-state and optional gradient diagnostics; excludes that epoch CSV append, scheduler/checkpoint serialization and console printing.
field_meanings.checkpoint_wall_seconds: elapsed_before plus current-call monotonic elapsed since wall_start. Prior saved latest25 duration is restored as elapsed_before. A checkpoint payload clock read occurs before saving that checkpoint.
field_meanings.DONE_wall_seconds: Restored latest25 wall_seconds plus resumed-loop monotonic elapsed at report construction; includes successful checkpoint saving and checkpoint hashing through that report clock read, excludes DONE writing, final workspace mirroring and initial setup. This is cumulative loop accounting across committed epochs, not full process elapsed, GPU utilization time, or only the resumed call.
